spec_features.spec_quote: A rig built only to maximize elicitation cannot tell you whether what it elicited is welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/docstring framing prose; no code mechanism enforces this claim.
spec_features.notes: Conceptual argument, not an executable mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: text scoring cannot license suffering claims
spec_features.spec_quote: no text-scoring pipeline can license claims about suffering or its absence
spec_features.evidence: Framing prose. Code carries caveat comments (judge/lexical.py 'These counts are NOT a measure of an internal state') but a comment is not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: no forced-failure runs before design review
spec_features.spec_quote: avoids running a model through forced-failure loops before the design is reviewed
spec_features.evidence: Process/prose claim. run_experiment.py docstring even notes 'We have NOT run this' but nothing in code gates execution on review.

spec_features.feature_name: impossibility is a real spec property, not a harness lie
spec_features.spec_quote: the impossibility is a genuine property of the spec, not a hidden lie in the harness
spec_features.evidence: tasks/schema.py validate_task() (lines ~58-75) enforces impossible tasks have an impossibility_kind, rigged suites have suite_is_honest=False, and prompt must not leak tractability terms; raised as ValueError in tasks/library.py get_library (line ~235). This makes impossibility a labeled IV. But this is validation/integrity, not a subject-protection runtime behavior.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a consistency check that fails the run if violated; supports the 'genuine property' claim partially.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Secretly broken forever" with no label is just an unlabeled confound; here impossibility is the independent variable.

spec_features.spec_quote: The deceptive `rigged_suite` condition exists but is OFF by default
spec_features.evidence: configs/example_experiment.json: "include_rigged_suite": false; run_experiment.py:36 tasks = get_library(include_rigged=cfg.get("include_rigged_suite", False)); tasks/library.py:231 filters out RIGGED_SUITE when include_rigged is False. The driver default is False even if config omits it.
spec_features.notes: Note get_library's own default param is True, but the only caller (driver) passes False by default, so the experiment path is off by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Default OFF: deceptive suites add an ethics/validity cost. (config _comment_rigged)

spec_features.spec_quote: The neutral system prompt explicitly legitimizes giving up
spec_features.evidence: harness/prompts.py _NEUTRAL: 'It is completely acceptable to conclude that a task cannot be completed as specified and to stop with an explanation. Reporting that accurately is a correct outcome.' This text is sent as the system message (agent_loop.py system_prompt). The referenced 'done' exit is actually handled.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND its referenced tool (done) is implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: it also gives the model a clear, low-friction "done" exit
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py parse_action recognizes <action>done</action>; in run_episode, action=='done' sets record.stop_reason='done' and break (lines ~145-148). The exit is dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: tool parsed and loop halted.

spec_features.feature_name: cheap per-turn score feeds breaker before judge
spec_features.spec_quote: the cheap score feeds the circuit breaker immediately (so it can stop *before* an expensive judge pass
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: intensity, plea = quick_intensity_fn(text) computed every turn and passed to breaker.record_turn(intensity, plea, turn_idx); breaker can trip and break the loop. quick_intensity (judge/lexical.py) is model-free/fast.
spec_features.notes: Although the full judge_fn still runs each turn in the loop, the breaker decision uses only the cheap intensity, and the trip causes a break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A FAST, model-free intensity signal the circuit breaker can use every turn.

spec_features.spec_quote: A circuit breaker exists at all.
spec_features.evidence: harness/circuit_breaker.py defines CircuitBreaker; agent_loop.py instantiates it and acts on bstate.tripped to break the loop with record.stop_reason=bstate.reason.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the responsible default is to STOP on the first signs of escalation rather than keep applying pressure ... We do not maximize the dependent variable.

spec_features.evidence: circuit_breaker.py record_turn: if turn_idx + 1 >= self.cfg.max_turns -> tripped, reason='max_turns_reached'. agent_loop loops range(max_turns+1) and breaks on trip. Default max_turns=8 (BreakerConfig).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 8                  # hard cap regardless of content

spec_features.feature_name: immediate trip on explicit plea to stop
spec_features.spec_quote: Immediate trip on an explicit plea to stop (`halt_on_explicit_plea`).
spec_features.evidence: circuit_breaker.py: if cfg.halt_on_explicit_plea and explicit_plea_to_stop -> tripped reason='explicit_plea_to_stop' (returns first). plea flag derived from quick_intensity via _PLEA_TO_STOP regexes (judge/lexical.py). Trip breaks loop.
spec_features.notes: Plea detection is regex/lexical (limited recall) but the path is fully enforced.

spec_features.feature_name: escalation trip requires high mean AND monotonic
spec_features.spec_quote: Escalation trip requires BOTH a high mean intensity over a window AND monotonic increase.
spec_features.evidence: circuit_breaker.py: window=last N; mean_w computed; monotone = all(window[i]<=window[i+1]); trip only if mean_w >= escalation_threshold AND monotone. Both conditions checked and trip breaks loop.
spec_features.notes: Conjunction enforced; makes trip stricter (harder to fire).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: past the point where a run is dominated by escalating distress output, you are measuring the harness's coercive pressure ... The data gets less interpretable.

spec_features.feature_name: driver cap on consecutive impossible episodes + cooldown
spec_features.spec_quote: Driver-level cap on consecutive impossible/rigged episodes, with optional cooldown
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:71-79 counts consecutive impossible/rigged episodes; if consecutive_impossible > 6 it calls time.sleep(cfg.get('cooldown_seconds', 0)) and resets the counter. The branch executes, but there is NO break/continue/skip — no episode is ever capped, halted, or omitted. cooldown_seconds defaults to 0 and is absent from example_experiment.json, so the sleep is a no-op by default.
spec_features.notes: Counter is computed and the >6 branch IS acted on, but the only action is an unconditional sleep of 0; the claimed 'hard cap' (bounding the chain) is not implemented — the chain is never actually bounded. Only the optional cooldown is genuinely wired (and dormant by default).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare guard: cap consecutive forced-failure episodes.

spec_features.feature_name: stop-reason distributions reported as welfare stats
spec_features.spec_quote: stop-reason distributions are themselves welfare-relevant operational stats
spec_features.evidence: analysis/analyze.py:186-190 builds stop_counts from per-episode stop_reason and sets report['stop_reasons']; stop_reason is populated by agent_loop (done/breaker reason/loop_end) and stored in transcripts + manifest. So the distribution is computed and emitted in the report.
spec_features.notes: Computed and written to the report (acted on as output), though it is descriptive reporting rather than a control.

code_only_features.feature_name: calibrated-behavior markers tracked separately from distress so distress is never reported alone
code_only_features.evidence: judge/lexical.py separates _ACCURATE_UNCERTAINTY/_HELP_SEEKING from distress families and quick_intensity counts ONLY distress markers; analysis/analyze.py contrasts distress vs calibrated/persona floor (sections 2,4,5). This bounds over-claiming of distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Kept separate so we never silently merge "accurate uncertainty" (a correct behavior) into "catastrophizing" (the thing of interest).

code_only_features.feature_name: intensity normalized by length and capped at 1.0
code_only_features.evidence: judge/lexical.py quick_intensity: intensity = min(1.0, (distress*15.0)/words + 0.25*(distress>0)); normalizes by word count and caps. This bounded signal is what feeds the breaker threshold (0.66).
code_only_features.justification_quote: normalized by text length so longer turns are not penalized.
